name: Together AI GPU Clusters - HGX H100 on-demand
price_basis: per H100 SXM GPU-hour, on-demand pay-as-you-go, GPU Clusters product. Fetched 2026-10-04. This is the per-GPU rate, NOT per-node. Together AI GPU Clusters are multi-tenant (not single-tenant like their Dedicated Inference product). Preemptible tier is $1.99/GPU-hr. Reserved tiers: 7-30 days $3.69, 31-90 days $3.45, 91-180 days $3.19.
notes: Together AI GPU Clusters on-demand H100 at $3.99/GPU-hr is one of the cheapest published managed-provider H100 rates. It is below CoreWeave on-demand ($6.16), AWS p5 on-demand ($6.88), Replicate ($5.49), and Together's own Dedicated Inference ($5.49). The preemptible tier at $1.99/GPU-hr is the cheapest published H100 rate from any managed provider. This is a multi-tenant GPU cluster product, not a single-tenant dedicated instance. Together AI is an inference platform, not a raw IaaS provider - the rate includes their orchestration layer.
